title: Darkness retreat study testing for spikes in natural DMT

tellings.quote: myself and New Nordics, um the group that I work with in Florida, we're funding a study where they're going to

plain: A researcher named Andrew Gallimore, who studies DMT, a powerful psychedelic that the body may also make in small amounts, says that in 2025 he and a Florida group he works with, called New Nordics, were funding a study. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that the study would put people through a retreat in total darkness to test whether their own natural DMT levels spike. If it showed that, it would support the idea that the brain can open strange inner experiences on its own.
